reviews_verbatim_used.text: I met Bruno, Paul brother, and he recommended him for a landscaping job I need at home. Paul and his company, Green MaxX Landscaping, are very professional and gave me ideas on how to manage my garden, even though it was a small project. ...

reviews_verbatim_used.text: On time for consultation and work. Did all work for quoted price and ensured all needs were met. Performed black olive branch removal, palm trimming and bamboo overgrowth removal. Great service at a great price.
